summary: Iteration 7 full test (backend + frontend) - all 4 new features PASS plus regression. Backend pytest: 10/10 pass (audit trail records SUBMITTED+APPROVED, PDF endpoint returns application/pdf %PDF header for daily/weekly/monthly, 400 on invalid period, 403 for data_entry, Excel import parses .xlsx with headers 'Date of block/Major Section/Dept/Line/Block description/Block allowed from/upto' and returns {imported:2, skipped:0, sheet:'Data Log'}, 403 for officer, 400 for non-.xlsx). Frontend Playwright: (1) Audit strip on /blocks toggles open, initially shows SUBMITTED event; approving a PENDING block via approve-<block_id> then re-opening shows both SUBMITTED and APPROVED events with actor names (Sr.DOM / R. Singh). (2) /reports has 3 report cards + 1 CSV card; all three PDF downloads return 200 application/pdf; CSV returns 200 text/csv. (3) /settings excel-import-form uploads a generated .xlsx, backend returns 'Imported 2 blocks · skipped 0 (sheet: Data Log)', new blocks appear on /blocks list (RB-IMP-* rows with descriptions TEST_ui_xlsx_A/B). (4) Filter memory: setting date=2026-09-10, section=GDBR – CNI, line=DN, navigating to /new and back preserves filters; full page reload also preserves them (localStorage key rbms_slot_filters). Regression: profile-name still 'Sr.DOM' for OFFICER001; notification bell dropdown opens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py excel_import: corridor lookup is done inside the row loop but with no caching - fine for now but for large workbooks precompute a dict keyed by major_section.

server.py excel_import inserts rows with status='APPROVED' but no approver stamp; audit log records 'IMPORTED' action which is good. Consider setting approved_by=admin employee_id to keep the data model consistent.
App.js AuditStrip re-fetches on every expand/collapse toggle - acceptable but could be cached at parent level to avoid flicker.
server.py /api/blocks search is a substring match on str(block).lower() - broad but works; not iter7-scope.
App.js Slots(): localStorage write happens on every state change; effectively persists as required. Good.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests inserted TEST_audit_trail, TEST_xlsx_row1/2 blocks via API. UI tests inserted TEST_ui_xlsx_A/B via Excel import at /settings. No cleanup endpoint available - persists in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 clean pass. All new endpoints in place: GET /api/blocks/{id}/audit, GET /api/reports/pdf?period=..., POST /api/admin/import. LocalStorage key for slot filters is 'rbms_slot_filters'. If future iterations touch the Blocks table, note that audit strip uses data-testid=audit-strip-<internal_uuid> not <block_id>; approve/toggle-audit buttons use the readable block_id (RB-YYMMDD-XXXX).
rca of the issue: No issue - all features work as specified.
